class.name: EditorExportPlatformSwitch
class.description: Exports the project as a homebrew [code].nro[/code] that runs from the homebrew menu. Export templates are built with devkitPro's devkitA64 and libnx ([code]scons platform=switch[/code]). Only the Compatibility renderer is supported.

members.member: Author shown in the homebrew menu.
Icon shown in the homebrew menu. Converted to a 256×256 JPEG. If empty, the project icon is used.
Title shown in the homebrew menu. If empty, the project name is used.
Version shown in the homebrew menu. If empty, [member ProjectSettings.application/config/version] is used.
If [code]true[/code], project resources are appended to the [code].nro[/code], producing a single file. Otherwise a [code].pck[/code] with the same name is written next to it.
Path to a custom [code].nro[/code] template to use for debug exports.
Path to a custom [code].nro[/code] template to use for release exports.
If [code]true[/code], also exports ETC2/ASTC compressed textures. S3TC/BPTC textures are always exported, as the console supports them.
